# GR8 GAMZ

Primary site: https://www.gr8gamz.com

GR8 GAMZ is a mobile-first browser gaming site with first-party GR8 Originals, a large GR8 Select catalogue, daily picks and My GR8 Arcade saved on the player device.

Main player routes:
- / - home page and primary start points
- /games - searchable and filterable game catalogue
- /gr8-originals - all GR8 GAMZ original games
- /gr8-select - large scrolling Select catalogue with real artwork
- /gr8-trending - focused high-action picks
- /gr8-daily - daily GR8 game spotlight
- /new-games - fresh GR8 Originals and Select picks
- /popular-games - strong repeat-play picks
- /quick-games - short-session GR8 Originals
- /mobile-games - touch-friendly GR8 Originals
- /car-games - car-led racing, parking, drifting and stunt collection
- /2-player-games - games with explicit two-player catalogue evidence
- /io-games - explicit .io arena and multiplayer collection
- /dress-up-games - outfit, fashion and makeover collection
- /shooting-games - aiming, target, sniper and action-shooter collection
- /word-games - word search, spelling, crossword and word-building collection
- /categories/{slug} - substantial category hubs generated from the registry
- /controls/{slug} - control-focused hubs generated from the registry
- /more-free-games - legacy More Games route for GR8 Select discovery
- /my-arcade - favourites and recently played games saved on this device
- /classroom - GR8 Classroom hub
- /classroom/timer - free classroom countdown timer

Game routes:
- /arcade/{slug} - playable GR8 Original profile and player page
- /more-free-games/{slug} - curated Select profile pages
- /more-free-games/{slug}/play - noindex external game play route

Trust and policy routes:
- /privacy
- /privacy-choices
- /cookie-policy
- /terms
- /partner-disclosure
- /affiliate-disclosure
- /about
- /contact
- /accessibility
- /child-safety
- /copyright
- /report-a-game
- /editorial-policy

Machine-readable routes:
- /sitemap.xml - indexable canonical URLs only
- /sitemap-index.xml - sitemap index
- /sitemap-images.xml - game artwork sitemap
- /robots.txt - crawl rules
- /feed.xml - RSS feed
- /feed.json - JSON feed
- /game-catalog.json - public game catalogue generated from the registry
- /api/partner-catalog - read-only catalogue data for the GR8 Select interface; not an indexable public page

Current public behaviour:
- No public accounts, chat, leaderboards or player profiles are enabled.
- My GR8 Arcade uses local device storage only.
- External games are not loaded until the player chooses to load one.
- Public pages should not claim live player counts, reviews, ratings or social activity unless backed by real production systems.
